# Nonconforming LD/residual two-core numerical experiments

The132 residual MP4/MKV pairs are LD profile counterexamples. See
`docs/LD_MPS_PROFILE.md`. Their132 ordinary MP4 controls and six24-frame bare
ELD controls remain positive. Native factories/exports must reject the residual
combinations;standalone numerical comparison is not codec acceptance.

Generate with `python3 scripts/generate_aac_eld_residual64_multicore_fixtures.py`.
Source windows,STP/GES flags and residual AAC syntax remain useful numerical
research inputs. Production decoding math was not validated as a standard
profile by their former successful synthetic playback. This correction
supersedes that earlier interpretation. No private media or parameter sets;
ordinary generation/tests use no FFmpeg,network or external process.
